en.headline: Organisers cancel Mega Fans Expo after Japanese performers denied entry
en.dek: The three-day adult entertainment event at the Regal Airport Hotel and a preview scheduled for Thursday have been called off, with refunds to follow.
body: Organisers of Mega Fans Expo 2026 have cancelled the event after reports that nearly 30 Japanese adult-video performers were refused entry on arrival in Hong Kong.

The three-day show, scheduled for Friday to Sunday at the Regal Airport Hotel, and a media preview planned for Thursday, will not go ahead, organisers said in a statement. They said refund arrangements would be announced later through official channels. Ticketing platform KKday also told buyers that orders would be refunded in full because of an immigration issue involving the artist group.

Several Japanese performers posted on social media that they or members of their teams had been turned away at Hong Kong International Airport despite having arranged visas in advance, and that they would return to Japan. Organisers did not give a reason for the cancellation beyond the statement of regret.
The expo had been billed as Hong Kong’s first large-scale adult fan event of its kind, with admission and interaction tickets previously on sale for the Chek Lap Kok venue.

zh.headline: 近30名日本女優疑遭拒入境 Mega Fans Expo主辦方宣佈取消
zh.dek: 原定富豪機場酒店舉行的三日成人展及周四預覽活動取消，主辦方稍後公布退款安排。
body: MEGA FANS EXPO 2026主辦方宣佈取消活動，原因是近30名日本成人影片女演員抵港後被拒絕入境的報道。
主辦方在聲明中表示，原定周五至周日在富豪機場酒店舉行的三日活動，以及周四的媒體預覽，均不會舉行，並對此表示遺憾。退款安排將稍後透過官方渠道公布。售票平台KKday亦告知購票者，因藝人團入境問題，活動取消，訂單將安排全額退款。
多名日本女演員在社交平台發文，指自己或團隊成員抵港後在香港國際機場被拒入境，儘管事前已辦理簽證，最終須返回日本。主辦方除表示遺憾外，未有進一步說明取消原因。
是次展覽被形容為香港首個大型同類成人粉絲活動，入場及互動門票早前已在赤鱲角場地公開發售。
